# UWA Profiles and Research Repository

> > The University of Western Australia's institutional research repository for discovering publications, research outputs, and staff profiles.

The UWA Profiles and Research Repository is an open platform maintained by the University of Western Australia for cataloging and sharing academic research, staff profiles, and student research outputs. The platform prioritizes accessibility and security through WCAG compliance and Cloudflare protection services.

## Core Repository

- [UWA Profiles and Research Repository](https://research-repository.uwa.edu.au): Main institutional research repository for publication discovery, staff profiles, and research outputs at the University of Western Australia

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Accessibility Statement](https://research-repository.uwa.edu.au/en/web-accessibility): WCAG compliance information and accessibility statement detailing screen reader support (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) and adherence to Public Sector Bodies Accessibility Regulations 2018

## Optional

- [Email Protection | Cloudflare](https://research-repository.uwa.edu.au/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): Cloudflare email protection and bot prevention service for research-repository.uwa.edu.au
